content: measured spacecraft characteristics of the version-1 sensitivity cases; every value is metadata, a measurement of the sampled load series, or a documented function of those. No generic spacecraft prior, typical dimension or typical coefficient is used anywhere.
supersedes: the unpublished analytic draft of this file, which used exaggerated dimension and torque scalings, vector-sum torque shares and invented CubeSat area-to-mass and ballistic-coefficient ranges

definitions.one_sided_projected_area_m2: A(u) = sum_i A_i * max(0, n_i . u) over the panel records, with u the unit vector pointing from the body towards the source/flow. This is the area the drag and radiation laws of the audited kernel actually use (they loop over panels with n.u > 0), so all force areas here are one-sided.
definitions.projected_area_bounds: Exact min/max of A(u) over the unit sphere, by enumeration of the cell interiors (u = +-w_S/|w_S| for every incidence subset S, w_S = sum_{i in S} A_i n_i), the cell-edge stationary points (orthogonal projection of w_S onto each panel normal and onto every pair plane), one interior point of each such plane and the cell vertices (+-unit(n_i x n_j)). f is piecewise linear in u, so these critical points contain its extrema; a deterministic direction grid is evaluated as an independent cross-check of every reported bound.
definitions.silhouette_columns: The harness logs projected_area_{wind,sun}_silhouette_m2 = sum_i A_i |n_i . u|. For a closed six-panel body and for a paired two-panel membrane this equals exactly twice the one-sided projected area, i.e. it counts both sides of the same body. It is a geometric diagnostic only and is never used as a force area here.
definitions.ballistic_coefficient_reference_kg_m2: m / (2.2 * A_wind) with the declared reference coefficient 2.2 of the classical definition; a convention, not a measured coefficient of the case.
definitions.ballistic_coefficient_effective_kg_m2: m / (mean_t Cd_eff * mean_t A_wind), and the peak variant m / (max_t Cd_eff * max_t A_wind). The coefficient is the one measured on the case's own samples; the product of the two separate time averages is used, not a sample-wise product.
definitions.effective_drag_coefficient: Cd_eff = -(F_drag . unit(relative_wind)) / (q * A_wind) with q the logged dynamic pressure 0.5 rho |v_rel|^2 and A_wind the logged one-sided wind-facing area. A two-sided or double-counted area would push this above the admissible bracket [2 sigma, 2 sigma + 4 (1 - sigma)] of the Sentman law F = -q A [4 (1 - sigma) sin^2(a) n + 2 sigma sin(a) v_hat].
definitions.effective_srp_coefficient: Cr_eff = -(F_srp . unit(to_sun)) / (P_sun * illumination * A_sun) with P_sun = (1361/299792458) * (AU/d)^2 Pa and d the spacecraft-to-Sun distance. The admissible bracket of the kernel's panel law is [1 - s, 1 + s + 2 d_opt/3].
definitions.torque_share: share_i = mean_t(|tau_i|) / sum_j mean_t(|tau_j|), i.e. a share of time-averaged torque magnitudes. It is NOT a share of the vector sum of the torques: the sources act at different instants and in different directions, so a vector-sum share would be smaller than 1 and is not reported.
definitions.angular_acceleration_consistency: alpha_body recomputed as I^-1 (tau_total - omega x (I omega)) from the logged total torque, body rate and principal moments, compared with the logged angular acceleration channel.
definitions.characteristic_times: Spin-rate and momentum-change times use the initial body rate and the largest sampled magnitude of the corresponding quantity; the orientation-change time is a constant-acceleration scaling sqrt(2 theta I_min / tau_max) with theta = 1 rad, valid as a kinematic scaling for zero-spin cases. No libration, resonance or period model is claimed.

declared_assumptions.assumption: optical specular 0.3 / diffuse 0.2, drag coefficient 2.2, Sentman accommodation 0.9
declared_assumptions.status: explicit exploratory assumption of this study

declared_assumptions.assumption: bus 0.1 x 0.2 x 0.3 m, six axis-aligned faces, centre of pressure at each geometric face centre plus (0, 0.001, 0) m
principal moments = uniform-bus tensor minus m*d^2 on Ix and Iz with d = 1e-3 m (centre-of-mass offset along body y)
declared_assumptions.status: analytic construction; every moment stays strictly positive and below the uniform-bus value

initial_conditions.note: these are the t = 0 source values; they are exact for the versioned configuration and carry no integration-setting dependence

mass_and_inertia.uniform_cuboid_note: the recorded moments reproduce the uniform-bus tensor of the inferred cuboid to 2.40e-04 in relative terms; the residual deficit is the centre-of-mass offset declared in the case configuration, not an independently measured mass distribution

statistics_scope.authoritative_at_t0: the configuration block, the panel records, the principal moments, the declared optical/aerodynamic coefficients, the initial body rate and the initial orbital elements are exact consequences of the versioned source and hold independently of any integration setting
statistics_scope.long_horizon_statistics: every mean, RMS, maximum and share below is a statistic of the single integration recorded in input.path, not a converged physical prediction; the convergence status of a case's final state is assessed in docs/numerical-audit/CONVERGENCE.md and not here

surfaces.panel_set_interpretation: every direction meets at least one panel, so the record sum is the physical surface area of a closed shell

centres_of_pressure.interpretation: the mean centre of pressure is a common offset of every panel; the residual lever of each panel is measured from that common point, so the two do not combine into a single lever arm acting on a common centre of pressure

cuboid_inference.method: edges from axis-aligned face areas: Lx = sqrt(Ay Az / Ax) and cyclic permutations
cuboid_inference.cp_plane_note: the comparison uses the residual lever measured from the common centre-of-pressure offset, so a common offset is not mistaken for a geometric edge

idealised_lumping_check.reason: panel set is not an antiparallel pair

point_mass_elements_at_t0.note: point-mass diagnostic of the initial state; with J2 enabled these elements are not conserved along the propagation

declared_assumptions.status: non-unique provisional mapping, not measured sail optics
